spark_open.description: The creature is a large, quadrupedal, tortoise-like animal shown in right-facing side profile standing on a small patch of sparse grass and bare dirt against a plain light background. It has a high, domed carapace covering its back and sides, colored in mottled browns and tans with dark radiating striations and prominent raised, pyramidal scutes. Its head and long, thick neck are extended forward and slightly upward and are covered in wrinkled, pebbly reptilian skin with a blunt beaked mouth and a dark eye. Its four thick, columnar legs beneath the shell are covered in long, shaggy, light tan to beige fur, with scaly, clawed feet at the ground, and a small, short, pointed scaly tail protrudes from beneath the rear edge of the shell among the fur at the back.

parts.looks_like: large polygonal scutes/plates with keeled, pyramid-shaped centers and concentric growth ridges, separated by light seams
